chapters.label: The big save
chapters.text: Basel, the 2025 Euro final. Penalties! Hannah Hampton has saved one already. Now Aitana Bonmatí, the tournament's best player. Hampton stays big on her line. She waits. Bonmatí hits it well... Hampton leaps to her right and palms it away!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Hampton stands big and still... then springs to her right!

chapters.label: Two saves
chapters.text: From the goal line: full stretch, strong hand! Two saves in the final, and England win the shootout.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Stay big on your line. Be patient: wait for the ball. Then dive!
